why.title: One environment to understand the past and decide the trajectory.
why.text: ABIX connects historical financial data, sector comparisons and future objectives. Assumptions, initiatives, risks and actual results remain tied to the diagnosis that informed them.

cards.title: Historical financial base
cards.body: Prefilled from data available in ABIX and expandable with the bank’s sourced internal data.

cards.title: Sector benchmarks
cards.body: Positioning against the market, status, size and relevant peer groups.

cards.title: Integrated management
cards.body: Objectives, initiatives, owners, deadlines, risks and actual results in one coherent record.

process.title: Build your three-year banking strategic plan
process.subtitle: From historical data to strategic objectives, ABIX supports the preparation, formalisation and management of your development plan.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.body: Historical financial data and sector benchmarks.

steps.title: Project
steps.body: Financial trajectories and three strategic scenarios.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: Pillars, objectives, initiatives, owners, deadlines and risks.

steps.title: Formalise
steps.body: A structured strategic record with optional AI writing assistance.

steps.title: Approve and manage
steps.body: Executive approval, Board approval, objective and actual-result tracking.

process.included: Feature included in the Corporate Executive Pack.

scenarios.title: Three views of the same trajectory.
scenarios.text: Assumptions are explicit and remain the bank’s responsibility. Scenarios support arbitration without replacing decisions by the competent governing bodies.

items.title: Base
items.body: Reference trajectory based on assumptions selected by the bank.

items.title: Ambitious
items.body: Stronger development objectives and the resources required to deliver them.

items.title: Adverse
items.body: A resilience view under more constrained assumptions.

dossier.title: Seven chapters to structure decision-making.
dossier.text: The record covers the main themes used to present the strategy, its resources, risks and governance.

ai.title: Writing support, never a substitute for decision-making.
ai.text: One complete drafting package per bank covers the scoping note and all 30 sections of the record.
quotas: 1 draft of the scoping note and all 30 sections
2 document prefills, up to 5 files per import
ai.engine: The non-AI ABIX engine remains free and unlimited.
ai.consent: AI drafting is optional and requires explicit consent before the necessary data is sent to the AI provider.
ai.responsibility: The bank remains responsible for its data, assumptions, decisions, validation and approval of the plan.

governance.title: A clear process from preparation to approval.
governance.text: Status changes and review stages organise internal work without claiming automatic regulatory validation.

offer.title: Advanced analysis and strategic planning in one offer.
offer.description: Up to 20 users · Data Explorer Executive 2022–2025 · Three-year strategic planning · AI assistance included
offer.existingCustomers: Existing Corporate Executive subscribers receive the module at no additional charge until their current subscription expires.

items.q: Does the Corporate Pack include strategic planning?
items.a: Yes. The three-year strategic-plan preparation and management module is included in the Corporate Executive Pack.

items.q: Does ABIX use my bank’s financial data?
items.a: ABIX prefills financial data available in the platform. The bank may supplement and correct it with sourced internal data.
No. The ABIX engine provides standardised generation without AI. AI assistance is optional and subject to consent before any data transmission.
No. Executive Management and the Board of Directors remain responsible for validation and approval.

items.q: Must existing Corporate subscribers pay extra?
items.a: No. Existing Corporate subscribers receive the new module at no additional charge during their current subscription.

items.q: Can progress against objectives be tracked?
items.a: Yes. The module compares three-year targets with annual actual results.

final.title: Move from diagnosis to a manageable strategic trajectory.
final.text: Discover the three-year planning module included in the Corporate Executive Pack.
